trello.name: Renew and Deploy SSL Certificates
trello.desc: Renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com before it expires on September 1st. Deploy the renewed certificate to the load balancers by August 22nd. Set up auto-renewal using cert-manager to prevent future manual renewals. Additionally, rotate the internal CA certificate that signs the service mesh, which expires two weeks after the public one.

trello.name: Implement PDF Export Feature for Reports
trello.desc: Develop the PDF export feature for reports. The backend should render the report to PDF using headless Chrome, while the frontend should add an export button and a progress state for large reports. Target completion by the end of the month. Include recording a short demo GIF for the changelog as part of this task.

trello.name: Ensure Staging Environment Parity with Production
trello.desc: Write a nightly job that checks if the staging schema is in sync with production and posts alerts to the infra channel if they diverge. Run the three pending migrations on the staging environment to bring it up to date with production.
